scope: Bundled review of the exact public native/glue diagnostic delta and eight injected offline tests. No protected final inputs/replies/scorer/processor/launcher read, no model/server/test replay or runtime modification.

justification.known: The existing retained metadata confirms all four request scope bindings, but retained ValueError/UNKNOWN has no HTTP status or actual exception transition.
justification.notProven: The old fixed-scope hypothesis and exact historical throw origin remain unsupported/UNKNOWN.
justification.smallestChange: Observe only fixed public transport/validation/readback phases and validated HTTP status in the existing exchange seam; no broad diagnostic platform or new evaluation criteria.

contentBoundary.httpStatus: Exact int type, range 100..599; strings, bools and out-of-range values become None.
contentBoundary.coreHttpRejection: Close HTTPError without reading its error stream; raise fixed NativeIngressError with no chained reason.
contentBoundary.invalidJsonAndOversizedResponse: Only a fixed code/status reaches the returned diagnostic; raw body is not added to result/error text.
contentBoundary.BottieRejection: Existing private event retention is unchanged; the public diagnostic contains only fixed rejection code and sanitized status.
contentBoundary.readbackFailure: May retain an already validated native answer in the original evaluator-only result as before; it never copies exception/database detail into the new metadata.
contentBoundary.publicationAdmission: No new public response/answer/raw event publisher added by this source change.

dependencyCompatibility.importMode: Existing public adapters use ordinary cp001_native imports; no new requirement for their imports/callback shape.

verification.testBoundary: Injected generic offline I/O: HTTP rejection, wrong success body, valid-looking error body/status, readback failure, normal envelope readback, unread/closed error stream, invalid JSON, Bottie rejection and sanitized invalid status/code.

limitations: GO covers diagnostic preservation on the public observer route, not a repaired historical product defect or valid comparison result.
The observer identifies its transition and HTTP status; it does not reveal a server traceback, infer cause from an old UNKNOWN or establish semantic quality.
No automatic new final run, protected-case replay, promotion or product installation is authorized by this review.
Original independent admission and accounting requirements apply before any future evaluation using these new source hashes.
